metadata.title: World Digest — October 31, 2026
metadata.summary: Washington and Warsaw clashed as Poland's president stormed its constitutional court and Iran threatened "maximum" strikes, while Nasdaq dive of 2.86% erased tech gains amid Intel's record 29% plunge.

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Poland's Top Court Standoff Escalates

Poland's president forcibly entered the constitutional court after judges were suspended, as police detained protesters amid accusations of a government "takeover." Financial Times POLITICO.eu The crisis underscores a deepening rule-of-law battle between Warsaw and Brussels. POLITICO.eu

Europe Braces for Massive Protests

France faces a third weekend of "high risk" demonstrations, with 150 rallies planned, as youth-led cost-of-living protests sweep Europe. France 24 Retailers warn of a bleak Christmas amid vandalism and boarded-up stores. The New York Times

Iran Threatens Maximum Response

Iran's supreme leader ordered a "maximum" response without "geographic limits" to any U.S. attack, following an apparent limpet-mine strike on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. Axios Al Jazeera

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Global Markets

  • Wall Street’s favorite stocks suffer their worst slump since 2010 amid collapsing AI enthusiasm, with the Nasdaq diving over 3% Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Alphabet lost a record $758 billion in October Barron's; Intel plunged 29%, its worst day since 1974 TechCrunch. Gold hit a one-year low below $3,900 Kitco.

Energy & Debt

  • Big Oil profits soared past $130 billion during the Iran War, while tankers defy attacks to keep Strait of Hormuz flowing NPR CNBC. Federal debt surpassed 100% of GDP, a first since WWII The Hill. Hedge fund Arini offloaded $800 million in debt as losses deepened WSJ.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content: Blockbuster fantasy A Court of Thorns and Roses Book 6 shattered Sarah J. Maas’ release record with 1.7 million copies sold Variety. General Hospital won Best Daytime Drama at the Daytime Emmys, though star Steve Burton’s custody texts cast a shadow TMZ The Hollywood Reporter. A settled lawsuit saw Leah McSweeney drop charges against Andy Cohen and Bravo Page Six. Selma Blair publicly apologized following her plane incident arrest NBC News.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Baseball

  • Brewers fans celebrate title — Tens of thousands flooded Milwaukee for the franchise’s first World Series parade, serenading coach “Murphy” ESPN ESPN.
  • Astros hire Randy Flores as new general manager ESPN.
  • Kaima Taira posted by Seibu Lions for MLB move; Michael King and Sonny Gray among 14 free agents ESPN ESPN.

Basketball

  • Warriors 112, Lakers 95 — Stephen Curry’s 31 points erased a 25-point deficit, outdueling Luka Doncic ESPN ESPN.
  • Mavericks 116, Rockets 111 — Irving (35) and Flagg (33) handed Houston its first loss ESPN.
  • Nuggets 127, Suns 120 — Murray’s 39 led Denver; Dillon Brooks ejected for kicking ESPN ESPN.

Football

  • Baylor 41, UCF 9 — Lagway threw 4 TDs in the interim coach’s debut ESPN.
  • Jets won’t trade Garrett Wilson, per source ESPN.

Hockey

  • Panthers 5, Jets 2 — Lundell’s hat trick capped Seth Jones’ record month ESPN.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Five companies debuted on Oct 30: OPay (NYSE, $19) Yahoo Finance, Aspen Neuroscience, Bambusa Therapeutics, Nordicus Partners (Nasdaq) [5–7]. Georgia Banking listed Oct 29 Yahoo Finance; upcoming: Narragansett Bancorp (Nov 2), Deep Sea Minerals (Nov 3) Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

S&P 500 fell 1.82% to 7,580.07; Nasdaq dropped 2.86% Yahoo Finance. Dow slipped 1.09%, Russell 2000 lost 1.66% Yahoo Finance. VIX spiked 12.91% to 19.42 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Tech cratered 4.89% Yahoo Finance. Energy led, +1.91%; Consumer Staples +1.41% Yahoo Finance. Financials (-0.76%) and Discretionary (-0.71%) held up better Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Nvidia fell 4.22% to $204.64 (most active) Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Broadcom dropped 5.48% Yahoo Finance. Apple -1.23%, Microsoft -1.55% Yahoo Finance. Berkshire edged +0.10% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Intel plummeted 28.6% Yahoo Finance; Reddit -29.2% Yahoo Finance. Gainers: CareDx +22.2%, Capri +16.3%, Regeneron +13.3% Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

10-year yield slipped to 4.93% Yahoo Finance. WTI crude surged 2.08% to $104.12; gold tumbled 3.29% Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin eased to $77,198 (-0.74%) Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 24–48 Hours

  • Iran–US escalation: Supreme leader’s “no geographic limits” threat raises Strait of Hormuz risk; tanker traffic holding, but oil above $104 could spike on any incident.
  • French protests: Third weekend of 150 rallies may disrupt retail ahead of Christmas; watch for government concessions.

Next Week

  • Tech rout deepens? Nasdaq’s 3% drop and Intel’s 29% crash may trigger further AI-sector selling; VIX near 20 suggests fragility.
  • IPOs: Narragansett Bancorp (Nov 2), Deep Sea Minerals (Nov 3) test risk appetite amid volatility.

Next Month

  • Poland–EU standoff could escalate sanctions or legal action; Brussels response likely shapes rule-of-law precedent.

theme.name: Fractured Circuit
theme.note: A day of broken institutions and shattered markets, where every line of defense — courts, markets, reputations — is being stormed or gutted.
